options.RNGButton.farlands.tooltip: Removes the noise overflow fix that pushed the farlands out of vanilla bounds. Up to 26.2 this created normal farlands, in 26.3 the overworld does something else.
options.RNGOptions.gaussian.tooltip: Controls some aspects of particles, although this is secondary to the other random sources.
options.RNGOptions.gaussianValue.tooltip: No info on bounds. Default value is 0.0.
options.RNGOptions.legacy.tooltip: Controls pretty much any other aspect of world generation, like structures and loot tables. Also controls most other random functions, such as fire spread and mob pathfinding.
options.RNGOptions.legacySeed.tooltip: Must be larger than ?. Default value is the max.
options.RNGOptions.mobFix.tooltip: Fixes a problem when disabling Legacy Random where entity UUIDs are not random anymore. This includes entities like lit TNT. Be extremely wary of thunderstorms with this enabled.
options.RNGOptions.singleThreaded.toolti: Controls some particle aspects, stars, and elements mainly related to rendering.
options.RNGOptions.singleThreadedSeed.to: Must be larger than ?. Default value is the max.
options.RNGOptions.structureFix.tooltip: Fixes a problem when disabling Legacy Random where legacy structures (strongholds and nether fortresses) fail to spawn. With this enabled, the game is made completable again.
options.RNGOptions.threadSafeLegacySeed: Number output by Thread Safe Legacy
options.RNGOptions.threadSafeLegacy.tool: Controls some sounds, including placing blocks and hitting mobs.
Must be larger than ?. Default value is the max.
options.RNGOptions.title: RNG Options
options.RNGOptions.xoroshiro.tooltip: Controls most world generation, including caves and features, and some aspects of mob spawning such as sheep color.
options.RNGOptions.xoroshiroSeed.tooltip: With some certainty, must be larger than 2701463235000000000. Lower values will cause unpredictable issues or crash. Some higher values will also crash. Default value is the max.
